description: Core infrastructure for FireForNet - Firebase SDK for .NET
releaseNotes:
v1.0.1-preview.31
- Added build-time configuration generation: the package now ships its MSBuild generator, so referencing it compiles values from the Firebase console files you already have (`google-services.json`, `GoogleService-Info.plist`) into your application as C# source. Opt in with `FirebaseBuilder.UseGeneratedConfiguration`. Explicit builder assignments always win over generated values, in any order. There is no runtime file to bundle, no JSON parsing at startup, no extra tool to install, and no network or credential access at build time.
- Added platform-scoped app id fields (`AndroidAppId`, `AppleAppId`, `WebAppId`) and `AndroidPackageName` for `google-services.json` files that describe several Android clients (build flavors). `FirebaseOptions.AppId` and `FirebaseOptions.ApiKey` now carry the active platform's resolved values (scoped field, then flat `AppId`, then generated value); the app id and API key of a selected Android client are always applied together, never mixed.
- Added `FirebaseBuilder.GeneratedConfigurationSet` for multiple environments: every set is generated and each registration selects one. Selecting an unknown set fails registration with an error naming the registered sets.
- Added `FirebaseOptions.OAuthClients` and the `FirebaseOAuthClient` entry type, plus the generated payload models `FirebaseGeneratedPayload`, `FirebaseOAuthClientRecord`, and `FirebaseGeneratedAndroidClient`. `FirebaseGeneratedConfiguration` is the registration seam used by generated code.
- BREAKING: renamed the Apple-scoped and web-analytics properties on `FirebaseBuilder` and `FirebaseOptions` - `IosClientId` to `AppleClientId`, `IosBundleId` to `AppleBundleId`, `AppGroupId` to `AppleAppGroupId`, `DeepLinkUrlScheme` to `AppleDeepLinkUrlScheme`, and `MeasurementId` to `WebMeasurementId`. The new names cover every Apple target (iOS, macOS, Mac Catalyst) instead of iOS alone. There are no aliases, so existing initializers must be updated.
- BREAKING: `FirebaseBuilder.ApiKey` and `FirebaseBuilder.ProjectId` are no longer `required`, because generated configuration can supply them. Registration still validates both: a missing API key or project id fails with `CoreErrorCode.MissingConfiguration`.
- Requesting generated configuration that cannot be resolved fails registration with `CoreErrorCode.MissingConfiguration` instead of producing a partially populated `FirebaseOptions`.

v1.0.1-preview.27
- BREAKING: FirebaseOptions and FirebaseBuilder now carry EmulatorHost (bare host, default "localhost"), EmulatorPort (int, default 9099), and an explicit UseEmulator flag, matching the per-service options shape. A combined "host:port" EmulatorHost string is no longer accepted; set UseEmulator = true to direct requests at the emulator.
- Introduces FirebaseEmulatorEndpoint, the single owner of emulator address normalization and URL composition. Parse accepts host, host:port, and scheme-qualified http://host:port input and composes canonical http:// URLs; For(host, port) returns a cached instance for hot paths.
- Introduces FirebaseEmulatorHosts.Resolve: at service registration, the loopback emulator defaults (localhost and 127.0.0.1) are rewritten to 10.0.2.2 automatically on Android, so the default configuration works inside an AVD with no platform-specific code. Mirrors the official Flutter SDK's automaticHostMapping. Every other host (a LAN IP for a physical device) is respected verbatim; set AutomaticHostMapping = false on the builder to keep loopback addresses verbatim, e.g. for adb reverse setups.

v1.0.1-preview.22
- Removed the default scope's JsonStringEnumConverter(JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase) policy: scopes no longer reshape built-in type shapes. Type-level [JsonConverter] declarations are now honored everywhere; plain enums follow the System.Text.Json default (numeric). See docs: JSON Serialization.
- Introduced IWireString<TSelf> and WireStringJsonConverter<TSelf>: type-owned string wire contracts (the Timestamp pattern generalized).
- Added JsonScopeSerializer.Serialize(Utf8JsonWriter, object?, Type, JsonSerializerOptions) - the runtime-type derivation primitive for residual wire values.
- BREAKING: the default ignore condition is now Never (the plain System.Text.Json default): null values are written. Wire types that require null-omission declare it per property ([JsonIgnore(Condition = WhenWritingNull)]).

v1.0.1-preview.13
- Added JsonScopeSerializer buffer-backed overloads: Deserialize<T>(ref Utf8JsonReader, string), Deserialize<T>(ReadOnlySpan<byte>, string), and Serialize<T>(IBufferWriter<byte>, T, string). These enable the Firestore proto-to-JSON bridge to serialize and deserialize without intermediate string allocations.

- Deleted CoreErrorCode.LocalCacheFull (Firestore concept that leaked into Core); service-specific codes now live entirely in their owning packages.
- CoreErrorCode returns to being a pure Core/transport vocabulary.
